queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Liaoyuan municipal government portal, its linked Liaoyuan Natural Resources Bureau site, the official Jilin Natural Resources portal, and the official Jilin Tianditu public geospatial platform. No public anonymous Liaoyuan parcel feature service with a safe native parcel ID and full geometry was identified.
